notes: Mobile Harness Code v1.19.8 — per-project protection and portability. Every workspace project now shows three honest status lamps (GitHub / Signiffia / Cloud) and can be backed up and restored independently: source code + .git history + bound signing keys encrypted in one container, version retention, fingerprint-verified restore, keys-only restore, and "Load existing project" from a storage folder (Google Drive or any folder via the storage framework). The new-project flow gains a signing-key step (none / existing / new) with optional auto-backup, so the original key is protected from the very first build. Providers, agents, RuntimeBridge and Standard Mode are unchanged. Signed (V2) with the unchanged production certificate.
